name: Football Duels [WR VS CB] ANIMATIONS!
desc:
USE CODE 2026 FOR COINS!

CELEBRATION ANIMATIONS ADDED TO THE GAME!

🎮 Get ready for adrenaline-fueled action in FOOTBALL DUELS! 🏈

Challenge your friends in 1v1 matches, battle in King of the Hill, survive Lob Elimination, or try the NEW WR vs CB mode - 1v3 passing action with an Auto QB! 💪🏆

⭐ GAME MODES ⭐
🏈 1v1 Competitive Matches
🏈 King of the Hill
🏈 Lob Elimination
🏈 Toss Game
🆕 WR vs CB (Pass Challenge) - Request passes with Q/E/R/T, works on Mobile & Gamepad!

⭐ FEATURES ⭐
📊 Full Stats & Profile System - Track wins, Elo, match history & head-to-head records
🎁 Gamepass Gifting - Gift gamepasses to friends from the shop
🛡️ Anticheat System - Play fair or face removal
⚖️ Elo Ranked System - 13 ranks from Rookie to GOAT

🕹️ CONTROLS 🕹️
• Click to catch
• E to dive
• Q/E/R/T for pass requests (WR vs CB mode)

🛠️ HELP 🛠️
🏈 Minimum of 5 players in a server for stats to count
❗ Exploiting/Boosting/Lowering FPS for unfair advantage is not allowed
